params.param: Mensaje de prueba para la tarea Docker.

tasks.task: echo "[task-conda] python: $(which python)" python -c "import sys; print('Python', sys.version.split()[0])" echo "Ejecutado dentro del entorno conda" > ${workingDir}/conda-output.txt
echo "[task-docker] contenedor: $(head -n 1 /etc/os-release)" echo "[task-docker] dockerMsg: ${dockerMsg}" echo "Ejecutado dentro de Docker" > ${workingDir}/docker-output.txt
echo "[task-bash] bash: $BASH_VERSION" echo "Ejecutado con bash, sin entorno conda" > ${workingDir}/bash-output.txt cat ${workingDir}/conda-output.txt cat ${workingDir}/docker-output.txt
